reviews.title: THIS IS AN ABSOLUTE STEAL!
reviews.comment:
This thing is such a steal at $98. Although it is now $104 as of the making of this review. But still, for that price this monitor is a steal.
First, the size is 27 inches. An IPS panel this size at this price is great.
Second, the picture quality is great. Of course it's no OLED or QLED but for an IPS panel, this thing rocks. The color accuracy is on par with most IPS panel at higher price out of the box. But you can easily tweak these settings to get the best color accuracy out of this monitor. But then again, you can just turn on HDR and Auto HDR on Windows 11 to get the best possible color profile for this monitor, being it is HDR capable.
Third, it has adaptive sync with 144hz refresh rate and 1ms MPRT. So if you like gaming like I do, this monitor will definitely do the job. It actually punches above it's weight. I have the response time to normal setting in this monitor and I experience no noticeable lag when playing online FPS games even with MPRT is off. There's no noticeable ghosting either. Just absolute smooth gameplay. I also use this for video editing and music production and it has been great on both as well.
But one of the biggest reason why I purchased this monitor was the features it has for eye care. I needed a monitor that will help my eyes be less strained on pro long use of the PC. This monitor has Anti Flicker and is TuvRheinland Certified, which many monitors at this price point does not have.
Overall, the functionality and performance of this monitor definitely makes this monitor a steal at this price. Seems durable enough, not that you're going to punch this after rage quitting an online match but it definitely doesn't feel cheap and on par with most gaming monitors at around and above this price point. You can also VESA mount it if you don't like the plastic, but durable, stand.
For reference, I use this as an external monitor on my 2022 Razer Blade 15. I don't know why I waited this long to buy an external monitor for gaming, video editing and music production. But I'm glad I found this gem. Grab one before the manufacturer realize that this monitor should be more expensive and raise the price.
reviews.author: Ron
